tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: A venue's current menu with prices (AUD), descriptions and dietary tags (vegetarian, vegan, gluten free). Optionally filter to one section, e.g. "desserts" or "cocktails".

venue.description: Venue name or slug, e.g. "Assembly", "corella", "Local Burleigh".

section.description: Optional section or menu name to filter to.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One venue's address, phone, structured opening hours (for 'is it open now'), booking method with the booking link, menu link and map link.

venue.description: Venue name or slug, e.g. "Assembly", "corella", "Local Burleigh".

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: All Rabble venues in Canberra and Burleigh Heads: type, suburb, hours and how to book (online, walk-in or enquiry).

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Show the guest a page on this site: a venue, its menu, what's on, functions or bookings.

venue.description: Venue slug for venue/menu pages, e.g. "assembly".

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: How to book a table at a venue. Returns the booking link (with the guest's date and party size filled in where the provider supports it) for the guest to choose a time and confirm, or explains that the venue is walk-in or enquiry only. Does not make a booking itself.

venue.description: Venue name or slug, e.g. "Assembly", "corella", "Local Burleigh".

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Upcoming gigs, events and specials across the venues (or one venue), with dates, start times, entry and ticket links.
